scripts.dev: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --ui "npm run seed && npm run dev -w apps/web -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run --project rules && vitest run --project functions"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed && playwright test"
scripts.test:e2e:http: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed && (node scripts/api-server.mjs &) && VITE_API_BASE=/api playwright test --project chromium"
